sample: Exact frozen 60 stage-09 positions, paired exploratory extension; not independent validation.
outcome: Assisted exact official first move. Same prompt, FEN, piece list, unranked legal choices and whole-answer UCI/canonical SAN scoring.
capability_gate: Eight fixtures: all completed and usable; both side and legal checks correct, at least two of four mates correct. Stop after two consecutive infrastructure/generation-limit failures.
analysis_gate: All 60 attempted; at least 58 provider-completed, at least 15 successes and 15 failures.
regression: Separate binomial GLM: success ~ (rating-1500)/500 + multiple-solver-moves indicator. 95% model-based intervals.
tree: Descriptive numeric CART, depth 2, min leaf 10; rating, solver moves, legal moves. No held-out accuracy claim.
interpretation: I assess the association between human-rated difficulty and assisted first-move success. Shared cases are paired. I do not pool them as independent observations or claim a causal family effect. Mistral high reasoning is not equivalent compute to other providers low settings.
retry: Only identical requests on transport/429/5xx, at most five attempts. Never retry wrong/format/length answers. Monthly/daily quota or wait >120s pauses collection.
